content_alignment_notes: CAPS term/content alignment requires educator confirmation.

required_visuals.title: Text response and language planner
required_visuals.assessment_use: Learners plan reading/viewing and writing responses.

generation_constraints: Plan visual evidence before writing questions.
If a question references a map, graph, table, diagram, source, performance space, or practical setup, the matching visual must be present in required_visuals.
Do not create blank source placeholders unless the task explicitly requires the educator to insert an external source.
Use the visual as assessable evidence: questions must ask learners to read, complete, compare, cite, label, calculate from, or reflect on it.
validation_rules: No learner-facing question may refer to a missing visual.
Every required visual must have a clear assessment role: stimulus, learner workspace, marking evidence, or moderation evidence.
Visuals must match subject, phase, term/content focus, and assessment family.

sections.title: Section A: Integrated Comprehension, Summary and Language Structures
sections.instructions: Read the following text and answer the questions that follow.
sections.stimulus: A cartoon advertisement for a new smartphone.

questions.question: What is the main idea of the cartoon advertisement?
memo: The main idea of the cartoon advertisement is to promote the new smartphone as a status symbol.

questions.question: What language structure is used to convey the main idea?
memo: The language structure used to convey the main idea is a complex sentence with a subordinate clause.

sections.title: Section B: Cartoon, Advertisement or Infographic Analysis
sections.instructions: Analyze the following infographic and answer the questions that follow.
sections.stimulus: An infographic showing the benefits of a healthy lifestyle.

questions.question: What is the main message of the infographic?
memo: The main message of the infographic is that a healthy lifestyle can improve overall well-being.

questions.question: What visual element is used to convey the main message?
memo: The visual element used to convey the main message is a bar chart showing the benefits of a healthy lifestyle.

sections.title: Section C: Editing for Grammar, Diction, Register and Punctuation
sections.instructions: Edit the following text to correct any grammatical errors and improve the overall clarity.

questions.question: What is the correct grammatical structure for the sentence?
memo: The correct grammatical structure for the sentence is a simple sentence with a subject and a predicate.

questions.question: What is the correct register for the text?
memo: The correct register for the text is formal.

sections.title: Section D: Formal Transactional Writing and Controlled Response Planning
sections.instructions: Plan a formal transactional letter to a friend.

questions.question: What is the main purpose of the letter?
memo: The main purpose of the letter is to inform a friend about a recent event.

questions.question: What language structure is used to convey the main purpose?
memo: The language structure used to convey the main purpose is a formal letter with a greeting and a closing.

rubric.descriptor: The learner demonstrates a clear understanding of the text and is able to identify the main idea and supporting details.
The learner demonstrates a clear understanding of language structures and is able to identify and correct grammatical errors.
The learner demonstrates a clear understanding of visual literacy and is able to analyze and interpret visual information.
The learner demonstrates a clear understanding of transactional writing and is able to plan and write a formal letter.

teacher_review_checklist: Verify that the learner has demonstrated a clear understanding of the text and is able to identify the main idea and supporting details.
Verify that the learner has demonstrated a clear understanding of language structures and is able to identify and correct grammatical errors.
Verify that the learner has demonstrated a clear understanding of visual literacy and is able to analyze and interpret visual information.
Verify that the learner has demonstrated a clear understanding of transactional writing and is able to plan and write a formal letter.
